items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: As it turns out, they live in a house that was designed by Frank Lloyd Wright.

ctx.x: Interesting story behind that recording. I was working at the Jazz – not the Jazz – Lush Life. This woman comes up to me. She’s got a mink coat on and dripping in diamonds and stuff, and she says, “Listen. You’re my husband’s favorite pianist.” I was, “Oh yeah. Okay. Nice.” “And I’m planning a birthday party for him. We live in Tulsa. I would love to you come as a surprise and play for my husband’s birthday.” I wasn’t too keen on that. “How much would you want?” So I asked for a lot of money, and she said,…
Shall I go ask Herb when I get back to the Bay Area?
